jobs.title: Program Director
jobs.description:
Benefits

401(k)
Bonus based on performance
Competitive salary
Employee discounts
Free uniforms
Training & development

Life’s too short to not work someplace awesome! If you have tons of energy, love kids, and are looking for a way to give back to your community, you may be the person we are looking for!

Why is The Little Gym a great place to work?

Strong sense of fulfillment
Keep fit as you work
Fun, high-energy work environment
Competitive compensation
Comprehensive ongoing career training
Excellent opportunity for career growth and advancement

About Us

With more than 300 locations across the globe, The Little Gym is the world’s premier enrichment and physical development center for kids 4 months through 12 years. For over four decades, The Little Gym has helped millions of kids experience the thrill of achievement, develop new skills, and find new confidence through a variety of gymnastics-based programs. Parent/Child, Pre-K, and Grade School classes.

At The Little Gym of North San Jose
, we create a fun, clean, and nurturing environment where children learn, grow, and build confidence. Join our caring team and help make a lasting impact on children and families in our community.

The Role

Are you energetic, love working with kids, and thrive on bringing out the best in people? As our Program Director
, you’ll lead and develop our team, bring our curriculum to life, and create memorable “wow” experiences for every child and family.

If you’re passionate about leadership, making kids smile, and raising the bar
, you’ll feel right at home here.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership:

Lead the successful delivery of classes, camps, birthday parties, marketing initiatives and events while maintaining a fun, safe, high-quality environment.
Develop lesson plans, weekly themes, and program materials while monitoring class quality and student progress.

Team Leadership

Coach, train, and support instructors through feedback, professional development, hiring, onboarding, and scheduling.
Foster a positive, collaborative team culture that supports staff success and program quality.

Customer Experience

Deliver exceptional classes and experiences by bringing our proven curriculum to life while building strong, positive relationships with children and families.
Build trust with parents through excellent customer service and clear, thoughtful communication about their child’s progress and experience

Operations

Support daily gym operations by managing class schedules, waitlists, and front desk responsibilities.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe facility while supporting administrative needs.

You’d Fit Right In If…

You have experience in running an organization either in education, childcare, recreation, fitness, or hospitality.
You genuinely love working with kids and families and creating “wow” experiences.
You’re a natural leader who enjoys coaching, motivating, and bringing out the best in others.
You’re organized, dependable, and proactive, but know when to buckle down and get things done.
You’re high-energy, positive, and love having fun—high-fives and goofiness encouraged!
You’re a team player who’s always ready to learn, grow, and make a difference.
You are available to work evenings and weekends when needed based on the program schedule.

Compensation: $24.00 - $30.00 per hour

When you work somewhere this fun, it doesn’t even feel like a job.

Want to wake up excited to go to work every morning, confident that you’re making a difference while having a blast? You’ve come to the right place. The Little Gym is the world’s premier enrichment and physical development center for children ages 4 months through 12 years. Programs offer children a Springboard to Life’s Adventures by using movement-based learning and imaginative play to help build the confidence and skills needed at each stage of childhood.

For over 40 years, our trained instructors have nurtured happy, confident kids through parent/child classes, gymnastics, dance and sports prep, plus enjoyable extras like camps, Parentsʼ Survival Nights and Awesome Birthday Bash parties. As a part of The Little Gym team, you will be part of a family dedicated to the growth and development of children all over the globe. We are looking for fun, outgoing, talented individuals who are looking to make a difference in their community. If this sounds like you, check out our open positions!

All associated locations are independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchise, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of that franchise. All inquiries about employment at this franchise should be made directly to the franchisee, and not to The Little Gym Franchising Corporate.

jobs.title: Director of Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Harri

It's a great time to join Harri as we revolutionize the hospitality industry with our cutting-edge technology solutions for workforce management. We're an innovative, high-growth company with a global presence, dedicated to building strong partnerships and delivering measurable value to our customers.

We are excited to recruit for this pivotal Director of Partnerships role to ensure the continuous identification, negotiation, enablement, and growth of strategic partner networks within the Harri ecosystem. You will serve as the primary business representative for potential partners and a trusted subject matter expert, playing a key role in bringing strategic projects to market and driving overall revenue and channel growth.

What You'll Be Doing

As the Director of Partnerships, you will be responsible for strategic partnership development, including identification, negotiation, and enablement of new partners as well as overall portfolio management.

Your responsibilities will include:

Serving as a key member of the strategy and business development team to define and deliver on new strategic growth potential.
Proactively seeking out new revenue/partnership opportunities and evaluating prospects through market research, sales collaboration, and industry assessments.
Leading commercial negotiations and contract execution on all terms and agreements, including security reviews and integration requirements.
Creating partner-level go-to-market campaigns in collaboration with strategy, sales, and marketing teams.
Managing the ongoing partnership portfolio, assessing performance through data analytics, and delivering partner scorecards.
Acting as the primary business representative at industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
Serving as the primary point of contact between executive stakeholders and partners from project inception through completion.

More About You: What Can You Bring?

We are looking for an individual who is passionate about the Restaurant and HR Technology ecosystem with a proven track record of exceeding target goals and scaling partner programs. You will be passionate about delivering successful outcomes and possess:

3-5+ years in a partnership program management capacity.
Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or commensurate experience.
History of exceeding targets and driving channel business results.
Strong experience with Salesforce and other sales technologies and best practices for team enablement.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to bridge executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
Experience or background in HCM and/or the Hospitality/Service Industry is preferred.
An ambitious and self-motivated team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and efficiently manages prospect pipelines.

When and Where You'll Be Doing It

This is a full-time position.

Location: New York; Hybrid.

Travel will be required on an as-needed basis.

The salary range for this position is $150,000 - $170,000 (USD), depending on experience.

This role reports directly to the CFO.

What Will You Get in Return?

Creating an environment which enables our people to thrive is crucial for us. Harri offers a comprehensive compensation structure designed to support you throughout your career here. You'll get:

Competitive salary within the stated range.
The opportunity to drive critical projects for a high-growth, innovative company.
Experience working in a fast-paced, global environment.
A collaborative and supportive team environment.

Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

We're committed to building diverse talent at Harri and believe our strengths as a team come from having many unique perspectives. We value a healthy, vibrant, and inclusive organization that encourages everyone to be themselves at work. We are committed to valuing diversity and promoting equal opportunities for all and welcome applicants from all communities.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a complete listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time.

Strategic Partnership Development

jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
TerraBella Senior Living proudly serves thousands of residents and families offering a full range of lifestyle and care options including Active Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and short-term Respite. With a foundation rooted in purpose, hospitality, and connection, TerraBella fosters communities where both residents and Team Members thrive.

As part of one of the largest senior living organizations in America, TerraBella communities have earned Great Place to Work® certifications from 2022–2026. At TerraBella, culture, growth, and heart define who we are. We continually aspire and invest in learning and development opportunities that support our team members’ professional growth, ensuring every team member has the tools to build a meaningful and rewarding career.

TerraBella Senior Living is looking for a
Executive Director
to join our community.

Does working for the leader in the Senior Housing industry sound like the professional challenge you are seeking? TerraBella Senior Living offers significant opportunities for growth and career advancement. Employees are encouraged to take responsibility for their own careers. You'll be working with incredible individuals with boundless creativity.

Responsibilities

Responsible for the operation and management of the community in accordance with the standards and guidelines of the Owners/Board of Directors, Discovery Management Group, and federal/state/local laws and regulations.
Communicates and models a clear, customer focused vision, based upon a resident centered model of care.
Demonstrates the ability to identify and build relationships within the local area that drives businesses into the community, as well as effectively price the product, thereby maximizing top-line revenue growth and achieves appropriate market position.
Ensures the community has an effective external business development strategy in place, with clear accountabilities assigned, is able to articulate results and adjust plan accordingly to maximize referral leads and move-ins.
Develops a thorough working knowledge of state regulations, policies and procedures dictated for residents; ensures compliance.
Ensures all resident administrative files are well maintained, current and in compliance with state regulations.
Meets the financial targets with the goal to maximize capital partners’ return.
Functional knowledge of all operating programs including memory care, clinical, dining and social programs.
Prepares, adheres to the community budget.
Ensures budgeted revenue is achieved or exceeded by maximizing occupancy and room rate.
Reviews monthly financial statements, implements plans of action for deficiencies.
Manages key, non-labor operating costs in line with budgeted levels.
Processes and submits monthly expenses and budget data timely per policies and internal business controls.
Meets NOI and occupancy expectations.
Oversees all departments, maintaining full responsibility for efficient operations and compliance with the financial goals established in the approved Operating Budget.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, Hospitality, Hospital Administration, or Health related field.
Minimum of three years of managerial experience preferably in the senior living, health care or hospitality industries.
Previous management experience including hiring, coaching, performance management, daily operations supervision and discipline.
Previous sales experience preferred.
Demonstration of success in managing operating expenses.
Administrator License/certification
Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; inspires and motivates others to perform well.

Why Join Us

Discovery Senior Living Earned Coveted Great Place to Work Certification for 2025-2026!

A large part of what makes Discovery different from other companies in this industry is our willingness to embrace change. At Discovery Senior Living, we are constantly challenging how we are doing things to ensure the lifestyle we are offering our residents is absolutely the greatest value proposition in the marketplace. It’s just as important to us that the environment and culture for our team members are constantly refreshed. In addition, embracing and even encouraging change brings a never-ending supply of new energy to our business and our culture. That energy translates to other far-reaching positive impacts on our residents as well as our team members.

Find out what makes working at Discovery unique in the world of senior living. Discover Your Purpose!

Our Culture & Values

So often, what brings people together is deeply rooted in who we are and what we stand for. At Discovery Senior Living, we’re unified by certain, core values, which we call our “Pillars of Excellence.” They make up the fabric of our company, and include TEAMWORK, INTEGRITY, PERFORMANCE, ACCOUNTABILITY, COMPASSION, HARD WORK and CREATIVITY.

Individually, they are our virtues, and together, they make up a roadmap which helps us foster innovation and success.

Benefits You’ll Enjoy

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive pay, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, a 401(k) with employer match, paid training and career growth opportunities, wellness-related benefits, and additional support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. EOE D/V

A Note to Applicants

This job description outlines the general nature and level of responsibilities for this role and is not an exhaustive list of all duties. Qualified individuals with disabilities, as defined by the ADA, must be able to perform the essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation, as determined on a case-by-case basis.

Agency Policy

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies. Please refrain from contacting hiring managers directly.

Employment Scam Warning

We only post jobs on our official careers site and accept applications through that platform. We do not conduct interviews via text or social media or ask for personal or banking information.

Regulatory Compliance & Background Screening

Discovery Senior Living complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory requirements governing hiring practices, background screening, and workforce eligibility. Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of state-mandated and/or federally required background screenings, which may include criminal history checks, fingerprint-based screening, Level 2 background screening, registry verification, and other screenings required for healthcare and senior living roles with direct or indirect resident access.

Certain positions may be subject to additional requirements under federal programs, including CMS, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations, as well as state-specific licensing or regulatory agencies. Screening requirements vary by role and jurisdiction, and candidates must meet all applicable standards as a condition of employment. These measures support regulatory compliance and help maintain a safe, secure environment for residents, families, and team members.

Employment in Florida is contingent upon completion of a Level 2 background screening in accordance with Florida AHCA requirements. Applicants will be required to complete fingerprinting and background screening through the AHCA Clearinghouse. For more information, please visit: https://info.flclearinghouse.com.

Thank you for your interest in TerraBella Senior Living careers. If you have any questions about the position you are applying for, please contact the community directly.

No agencies, please. We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from agencies under any circumstances. We receive inquiries from agencies daily. Agencies should not direct any inquiries or emails to hiring managers. Thank you.

EOE D/V

jobs.description:
How many people can answer the question, "What do you do for a living?" with the answer, " I help find cures for cancer.
" At Blood Cancer United, employees take our mission seriously. Whether you work in one of our regions, are an accountant at the national office or a specialist in our Information Resource Center, you work each day on making our bold goal a reality: to enable patients with blood cancer to gain more than one million years of life by 2040.
Join us and give new meaning to the word, "job."

Summary:
As part of a mission centric, locally delivered and nationally powered organization this role is accountable for leading multiple staff teams and is able to build & maintain strong relationships with constituents while implementing innovative peer to peer fundraising products to exceed revenue goals for Blood Cancer United's mission, within a designated market area. Relentlessly pursuing cancer cures.

Key Relationships

Supervises:
Campaign Development Manager(s)

Leads:
Volunteers & Committees

Duties And Responsibilities

Mission Integration
Partner with Education Services and Health Research department to effectively communicate the Blood Cancer United overall mission, programs, resources and priorities.
Responsible for organizing mission centered, local donor cultivation events and prospecting high-impact donors for national stewardship activities

Staff Leadership & Development
Create and implement an innovative strategic plan annually and revise periodically to ensure team exceeds all revenue goals.
Teach, train and consult fundraising staff in designated market area
Responsible for the hiring, management, development & training of the peer to peer fundraising teams.

Volunteer Leadership & Development
Collaborate to grow volunteer and corporate relationships across the market and throughout Blood Cancer United.
Responsible for the recruitment and cultivation of high-level volunteer committees
Teach, train and consult volunteer leaders in designated market area
Responsible for the recruitment & cultivation of high level volunteer leadership.
Provide comprehensive volunteer support to ensure positive volunteer interaction.

Innovation in High Impact Fundraising
Accountable for achieving high-impact peer to peer fundraising revenue goals.
Responsible for retaining & upgrading sponsorship for all products.
Maintain a working knowledge of the Blood Cancer United mission and programs to promote Organizational initiatives.
Perform other related duties as assigned

Education & Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree
7-8 years of relatable experience

Position Requirements

Demonstrated track record of success
Demonstrated ability to develop high performing teams
Comfort with getting into the details as necessary

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Physical demands are minimal and typical of similar jobs in comparable organizations
Work environment is representative and typical of similar jobs in comparable organizations
Local Travel up to 30%.
Required to work some evenings or weekends.

Employee Value Proposition

As a valued member of Blood Cancer United, you are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 403b retirement plan along with generous paid time off. In addition, we observe federal paid holidays throughout the year, and offer a wellness program and an employee assistance program.

The offered compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, business need, market conditions, proficiencies, skills, education, and experience. Additionally, at Blood Cancer United we place a high value on internal pay equity and will consider the current compensation of similarly situated roles and direct team members. Base compensation is only one component of our Total Rewards program, which also includes an annual incentive plan and a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Utility Scale Development Director
jobs.description:
RWE Americas, LLC

To start as soon as possible, full time, permanent

Functional area:
Project Development

Remuneration:
Exempt

The Development Director, Utility-Scale Development - Central Region
at RWE Americas is a senior individual contributor responsible for initiating, developing, and acquiring utility-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects in the United States and Canada. The Director independently leads complex projects and cross-functional project teams from greenfielding through start of construction and supports projects through commercial operation. The role has no direct reports and delivers results by applying advanced development expertise, influencing internal and external stakeholders, and driving alignment with RWE’s North American strategy.

Role Responsibilities:

Develop and oversee utility-scale solar, wind, and energy storage projects from greenfielding through start of construction, with accountability for schedule, budget, risk, and project value
Serve as project lead for complex or high-priority projects, directing large cross-functional teams of internal subject-matter experts and external consultants without direct people-management authority
Manage the full project lifecycle, including site due diligence, land control, environmental review and permitting, interconnection, engineering and preconstruction, energy yield, tax abatements, power marketing, financing support, and readiness for construction
Define project strategy and critical-path priorities by integrating market, transmission, permitting, land, technical, commercial, financial, and stakeholder considerations
Establish and manage project budgets, objectives, schedules, forecasts, decision points, and deliverables; prioritize development spending based on project economics, risk, and market attributes
Lead cost-estimating and EPC-bidding activities in collaboration with Preconstruction, Procurement, Engineering, and Finance to improve cost certainty and support investment decisions
Drive optimization of engineering design, constructability, commercial structure, and other technical and financial levers to strengthen project competitiveness and risk-adjusted returns
Identify, analyze, and resolve high-complexity issues involving land, grid access, permitting, community opposition, project design, commercial terms, or competing priorities, escalating material risks with recommended actions
Lead critical negotiations with landowners, utilities, transmission providers, regulators, governmental entities, consultants, contractors, and strategic partners
Understand the key drivers of project financial attractiveness and identify strong project locations in collaboration with RWE’s commercial, transmission, and technical teams
Lead due diligence for project acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and other transactions in collaboration with RWE’s M&A and functional teams
Prepare executive-level presentations and investment recommendations and drive internal review and approval processes with clear articulation of project value, risks, tradeoffs, and required decisions
Support power marketing, financing, tax-equity, and transaction processes by providing project inputs, coordinating due diligence, and ensuring that development assumptions are accurate and supportable
Provide strategic and technical mentorship to Development Managers, Associates, and other colleagues; guide project work and share expertise without formal supervisory or performance-management responsibility
Actively shape Central Region development strategy and lead internal initiatives that improve development processes, tools, governance, standardization, and portfolio execution
Provide support during construction to resolve development-related issues and help ensure successful commercial operation

Job Requirements and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business/economics, environmental science, planning, public policy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
Minimum of 11 years of relevant work experience, including at least 4 years of utility-scale wind, solar, or battery storage development experience in the United States
Demonstrated success independently leading complex, capital-intensive energy or infrastructure projects through multiple development stages
Experience leading multidisciplinary project teams and managing external consultants, advisors, contractors, or strategic partners
Expert knowledge of utility-scale project development, including land acquisition, permitting, interconnection, engineering, preconstruction, stakeholder engagement, commercial structuring, budgeting, forecasting, and risk management
Exceptional project and portfolio management skills, including the ability to establish priorities, drive accountability, and deliver results across multiple complex workstreams
Proven ability to lead through influence, align diverse cross-functional stakeholders, and resolve disagreements without relying on direct reporting authority
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including the ability to assess project economics, development tradeoffs, capital requirements, and risk-adjusted value
Excellent analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to develop practical solutions to ambiguous or high-impact issues
Excellent executive communication skills and the ability to translate detailed project information into concise recommendations for senior leadership
Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with landowners, communities, government officials, regulators, utilities, partners, and internal stakeholders from diverse backgrounds
Motivated self-starter who is goal-oriented, detail-oriented, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently while contributing effectively as part of a team
Excellent proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams
Ability to travel up to 50%
This position is an office-based role with travel to other RWE Americas offices, project sites, public meetings, and field locations
Must be able to sit, walk, or stand for extended periods of time

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. RWE Americas is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

Pay range:
The annual base salary range for this position in Illinois is $190,000 - $286,000. The listed salary range represents our good faith estimate for this position and represents the range for new hire salaries across all U.S locations. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. RWE considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s education & work experience, training & certifications, and key skills as well as market and business considerations at the time of the offer.

Benefits offered:
Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Education Assistance, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays. Eligible employees also participate in short-term incentives, in addition to salary.

ad code 93276.

rwe_americas_recruiting@rwe.com

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too.

RWE Americas, a subsidiary of RWE, is a US-based energy company that is helping to meet the growing demand for energy across the United States. Backed by RWE’s 125-year global legacy of managing diverse power assets, RWE Americas operates approximately 13 GW of power projects across 27 states. With a talented workforce of 2,000 employees, RWE Americas develops, constructs and operates wind, solar and battery storage projects that safely deliver affordable, reliable electricity to our customers. Committed to responsible development, RWE Americas invests in local and rural communities, creating jobs and partnering with stakeholders to support and strengthen the places where we live and work. Learn more about how RWE Americas is generating impact at americas.rwe.com.

At RWE Americas, we foster a culture defined by our Essential Behaviors – Have Courage, Create Impact and Actively Collaborate. We encourage bold thinking and continuous learning, and we value ownership, resilience and inclusion in everything we do. When you join us, you become part of a team that supports your development, respects your contributions and celebrates shared success. This is a place where you can grow your career and make a meaningful difference.

jobs.title: Regional Director of Operations
jobs.description:
📣 We’re hiring a Regional Director of Operations – Oregon!

At Compass Senior Living, we are Guided by Goodness, Loyalty, Faith, and Fun. It’s our True North — guiding how we lead, the decisions we make, and how we care for one another.

We believe senior living communities can and should be places of vibrancy and life — places that create meaning and joy for elders, their families, and the team members who serve them.

And we are continuing to grow, evolve, and elevate.

We’re looking for an experienced Regional Director of Operations to help lead our Oregon communities and be part of what comes next for Compass.

At Compass, we believe people make all the difference. We place tremendous importance on culture and believe trusting relationships are the foundation for caring for one another. That means this role is about much more than overseeing operations.

We’re looking for a leader who will listen, support, coach, challenge, develop, and empower our community leaders while creating the accountability necessary to achieve exceptional results.

Our next RDO will help us:

- Develop and empower strong community leaders
- Build cultures where team members feel valued, supported, and connected to purpose
- Drive operational and financial excellence
- Strengthen occupancy, retention, compliance, and resident satisfaction
- Remove barriers and create solutions alongside our communities
- Foster meaningful connections with elders, families, and team members
- Continue raising the bar while protecting what makes Compass culture special

We are looking for someone with strong Assisted Living and Memory Care operational experience, multi-site or regional leadership experience, financial acumen, and a proven ability to develop people and drive results.

But experience alone isn't what makes someone a Compass leader.

If you are ready to help us continue building that future and your leadership is Guided by Goodness, Loyalty, Faith, and Fun, we would love to meet you.

About The Role

Executive Director - Head of Energy Markets Research & Analysis, you will be a member of the research leadership team responsible for developing and stewarding olefin chemicals market research and analysis. You will report to the Vice President of Research.

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

Lead the development of new research products focused on the global coverage of energy markets, such as crude oil, natural gas, NGLs and refined products
Direct primary research and create analysis in support of new service launches; including research & analysis related to upstream production trends and refining landscape evolution
Acts as a liaison between Dow Jones Energy & external suppliers
Oversee the energy price forecasting process and communicate key forecast messages internally and externally
Establish and maintain a reputation for of energy market expertise (oil, natural gas, natural gas liquids and fuel product) by overseeing and deploying subject matter experts to industry events, media opportunities, client engagements and internal functions
Build and maintain industry contact relationships across producers, consumers, traders, and the financial community
Ensure that the team follows Dow Jones Energy price discovery standards
Collaborate with sales personnel to identify new business opportunities for sales and consulting engagements
Coordinate energy & feedstock market content for consulting projects and client development
Advise content leaders on research topics and ideas to improve existing weekly and monthly reports and strategic analyses
Develop market presentations and pursue opportunities to present information in client meetings and conferences
Actively market the energy & feedstock services
Contribute to Dow Jones Energy team dynamics to ensure consistent global coverage and analysis
Serve as a key stakeholder for marquee value chain events

You Have

15+ years’ upstream, downstream, and/or midstream industry experience, including market intelligence and/or strategic planning (prior experience creating and launching new products is a plus)
Experience in managing 10+ direct reports & mentoring skip-level reports which includes highly experienced multi-disciplinary, market experts
The ability to identify and articulate core/essential issues within complex problems and deliver insights and solutions
Experience managing ambiguity with minimal direction
Strong MS Office suite, PowerBI, Spotfire and/or Tableau experience

TerraBella Senior Living proudly serves thousands of residents and families offering a full range of lifestyle and care options including Active Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and short-term Respite. With a foundation rooted in purpose, hospitality, and connection, TerraBella fosters communities where both residents and Team Members thrive.

As part of one of the largest senior living organizations in America, TerraBella communities have earned Great Place to Work® certifications from 2022–2026. At TerraBella, culture, growth, and heart define who we are. We continually aspire and invest in learning and development opportunities that support our team members’ professional growth, ensuring every team member has the tools to build a meaningful and rewarding career.

TerraBella Senior Living is looking for a
Executive Director
to join our community.

Does working for the leader in the Senior Housing industry sound like the professional challenge you are seeking? TerraBella Senior Living offers significant opportunities for growth and career advancement. Employees are encouraged to take responsibility for their own careers. You'll be working with incredible individuals with boundless creativity.

Responsibilities

Responsible for the operation and management of the community in accordance with the standards and guidelines of the Owners/Board of Directors, Discovery Management Group, and federal/state/local laws and regulations.
Communicates and models a clear, customer focused vision, based upon a resident centered model of care.
Demonstrates the ability to identify and build relationships within the local area that drives businesses into the community, as well as effectively price the product, thereby maximizing top-line revenue growth and achieves appropriate market position.
Ensures the community has an effective external business development strategy in place, with clear accountabilities assigned, is able to articulate results and adjust plan accordingly to maximize referral leads and move-ins.
Develops a thorough working knowledge of state regulations, policies and procedures dictated for residents; ensures compliance.
Ensures all resident administrative files are well maintained, current and in compliance with state regulations.
Meets the financial targets with the goal to maximize capital partners’ return.
Functional knowledge of all operating programs including memory care, clinical, dining and social programs.
Prepares, adheres to the community budget.
Ensures budgeted revenue is achieved or exceeded by maximizing occupancy and room rate.
Reviews monthly financial statements, implements plans of action for deficiencies.
Manages key, non-labor operating costs in line with budgeted levels.
Processes and submits monthly expenses and budget data timely per policies and internal business controls.
Meets NOI and occupancy expectations.
Oversees all departments, maintaining full responsibility for efficient operations and compliance with the financial goals established in the approved Operating Budget.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, Hospitality, Hospital Administration, or Health related field.
Minimum of three years of managerial experience preferably in the senior living, health care or hospitality industries.
Previous management experience including hiring, coaching, performance management, daily operations supervision and discipline.
Previous sales experience preferred.
Demonstration of success in managing operating expenses.
Administrator License/certification
Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; inspires and motivates others to perform well.

Why Join Us

Discovery Senior Living Earned Coveted Great Place to Work Certification for 2025-2026!

A large part of what makes Discovery different from other companies in this industry is our willingness to embrace change. At Discovery Senior Living, we are constantly challenging how we are doing things to ensure the lifestyle we are offering our residents is absolutely the greatest value proposition in the marketplace. It’s just as important to us that the environment and culture for our team members are constantly refreshed. In addition, embracing and even encouraging change brings a never-ending supply of new energy to our business and our culture. That energy translates to other far-reaching positive impacts on our residents as well as our team members.

Find out what makes working at Discovery unique in the world of senior living. Discover Your Purpose!

Our Culture & Values

So often, what brings people together is deeply rooted in who we are and what we stand for. At Discovery Senior Living, we’re unified by certain, core values, which we call our “Pillars of Excellence.” They make up the fabric of our company, and include TEAMWORK, INTEGRITY, PERFORMANCE, ACCOUNTABILITY, COMPASSION, HARD WORK and CREATIVITY.

Individually, they are our virtues, and together, they make up a roadmap which helps us foster innovation and success.

Benefits You’ll Enjoy

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive pay, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, a 401(k) with employer match, paid training and career growth opportunities, wellness-related benefits, and additional support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Direct primary research and create analysis in support of new service launches; including research & analysis related to upstream production trends and refining landscape evolution
Acts as a liaison between Dow Jones Energy & external suppliers
Oversee the energy price forecasting process and communicate key forecast messages internally and externally
Establish and maintain a reputation for of energy market expertise (oil, natural gas, natural gas liquids and fuel product) by overseeing and deploying subject matter experts to industry events, media opportunities, client engagements and internal functions
Build and maintain industry contact relationships across producers, consumers, traders, and the financial community
Ensure that the team follows Dow Jones Energy price discovery standards
Collaborate with sales personnel to identify new business opportunities for sales and consulting engagements
Coordinate energy & feedstock market content for consulting projects and client development
Advise content leaders on research topics and ideas to improve existing weekly and monthly reports and strategic analyses
Develop market presentations and pursue opportunities to present information in client meetings and conferences
Actively market the energy & feedstock services
Contribute to Dow Jones Energy team dynamics to ensure consistent global coverage and analysis
Serve as a key stakeholder for marquee value chain events

You Have

15+ years’ upstream, downstream, and/or midstream industry experience, including market intelligence and/or strategic planning (prior experience creating and launching new products is a plus)
Experience in managing 10+ direct reports & mentoring skip-level reports which includes highly experienced multi-disciplinary, market experts
The ability to identify and articulate core/essential issues within complex problems and deliver insights and solutions
Experience managing ambiguity with minimal direction
Strong MS Office suite, PowerBI, Spotfire and/or Tableau experience
Advanced knowledge of Excel manipulation including VBA scripting (Python knowledge a plus)
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally
Chemical engineering, chemistry, business or, economics degree -OR- equivalent work experience (post-graduate academic work in a technical field such as PhD or master’s in data science chemical or petroleum engineering will be considered in lieu of experience)
